description: BGP communities that a RoutingPolicy term matches routes against: a route that carries one of them matches.

communities.description: The communities: standard communities `<AS>:<value>` of 16-bit numbers, or large ones `<AS>:<value>:<value>` of 32-bit numbers.

title: CommunityList

rules.description: A CommunityList holds standard or large communities, not both.
rules.messageExpression: documents.filter(n, cel.bind(c, documents[n].spec.communities, cel.bind(large, c[0].indexOf(":") != c[0].lastIndexOf(":"), !c.all(x, (x.indexOf(":") != x.lastIndexOf(":")) == large)))).map(n, "CommunityList " + n).join(", ") + " holds standard and large communities; give each kind a list of its own"
rules.rule: documents.all(n, cel.bind(c, documents[n].spec.communities, cel.bind(large, c[0].indexOf(":") != c[0].lastIndexOf(":"), c.all(x, (x.indexOf(":") != x.lastIndexOf(":")) == large))))
